name: SVC_AP_TEMPLATE_ACTIONS_
description: This table contains the association of actions to action plan templates.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Auto-generated unique number with a customizable format.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_AP_TEMPLATES.TEMPLATE_ID

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_AP_ACTIONS.ACTION_ID

columns.name: ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: The order of display for an action within an action template.

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the action in the action plan is mandatory (Y or N). If mandatory, an agent cannot disable the action from an action plan that uses the template.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the association record is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: CONDITION_ID
columns.description: The condition used for the template action. Foreign key reference to SVC_AP_CONDITIONS.CONDITION_ID.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_USER
columns.description: Indicates the user who created the row through domain-specific language service.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY_USER
columns.description: Indicates the user who last updated the row through domain-specific language service.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
